title: Space bound from choice-run intervals
statement: Let $N$ be a nondeterministic machine with $K$ work tapes, let $w$ be a choice word, and let $c$ be an initial configuration. Suppose that for every choice word $u$ of length at most $|w|$ and every tape $i$, the head position after running with $u$ lies between integers $\mathrm{lo}(i)$ and $\mathrm{hi}(i)$, inclusive. Then the total number of distinct work-tape cells visited along the run under $w$ is at most $\sum_i (\mathrm{hi}(i)-\mathrm{lo}(i)+1)$.
hypotheses_covered: Every choice word of length at most $|w|$ has all head positions within the stated bounds
